resources.string: Shows the orange and red weather warnings of Spain\'s weather service (AEMET) on the map and on routes. It asks AEMET\'s server (opendata.aemet.es) for its one national bundle of warnings, at most every 15 minutes, and compares it with your position on the phone: no position and no area is ever sent. It needs your own free AEMET API key, which identifies you to AEMET. Off by default.
A warning is information, not advice. The data can be late or incomplete: check AEMET (aemet.es) for the official text.
A key is saved on this phone.
No key saved. Weather alerts stay idle until you add one.

The key is stored encrypted in the Android Keystore, never written to logs and never included in backups or settings files. It identifies you to AEMET: AEMET (and your network) can see that this key asks for warnings, from your IP address.
That does not look like an AEMET API key. Paste it again, without extra text.
AEMET gives a free key to anyone who asks with an email address (opens in your browser).
Yellow warnings are only listed in the details of the warnings at the centre of the map. There is never a banner for them.
Checked a moment ago. AEMET is asked at most every 15 minutes.
The warnings are recent. They are renewed every 30 minutes at most.
AEMET did not accept this key. Check it or request a new one.
Could not get the warnings from AEMET. Nothing was changed.
